places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: The outfit crosses it and trots southeast by moonlight; Newt keeps track only by knowing the river lies to his left.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Newt's first night raid there; the dark empty brush country holds wild longhorns that bolt from the riders.

places.name: Hacienda Flores
places.note: The riders skirt an out camp and the big camp; Augustus calls it northern Mexico's best-armed ranch; the outfit splits to take the horse herd.
places.location_hint: northern Mexico (Coahuila), a few hours' trot southeast of the Rio Grande crossing near Lonesome Dove; horse herd lies south of the big camp

places.name: Flores wranglers' burnt-out camp
places.note: In a roofless hut by a broken corral, Call, Deets and Newt find two lost, hungry Irish brothers and promise to send horses back for them.
places.location_hint: on Hacienda Flores land, two or three miles south of where the riders turned past the big camp; brush and desert country southeast of the Rio Grande

places.name: Mexico City
places.note: Augustus mocks Call's caution, saying they needn't detour by way of Mexico City.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Call reflects that in his time it was easy to get killed there.

places.name: Ireland
places.note: The O'Brien brothers are Irish and miss their potatoes.

places.name: Galveston
places.note: The Irishmen's intended destination; Call says they badly overshot it.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Watching skittish wild longhorns bolt, Augustus jokes that cattle this fast could reach it in a week.

groups.label: Call's detail
groups.hint: loping south from the burnt-out wrangler camp toward the Flores horse herd

groups.label: Augustus's detail
groups.hint: sent to take the Flores horse herd, south of the big camp

groups.label: O'Brien brothers
groups.hint: waiting with a hobbled mule and a donkey for horses to be sent back
